svg.title: Black Curve
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study after an inspected primary museum photograph. Geometry approximate; interpretive screen colour not calibrated. White right corners are painted rectangular support, not missing wall. Black curved field meets both left corners. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of black, white; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://www.walkerart.org/collections/artwork/black-curve/; source object 1995.73; inspected 2026-10-27; hand-authored approximation.
